review_locator: PMCID:PMC4749266, The transcriptional control of the perforin locus; PMCID:PMC5241313, STATs in NK-Cells: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
primary_title: The human perforin gene is a direct target of STAT4 activated by IL-12 in NK cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify the human perforin gene as a direct STAT4 target in IL-12-stimulated NK cells; the cited primary demonstrates STAT4 binding to tandem STAT elements in the PRF1 promoter and loss of IL-12-induced promoter activation after mutation of either site.
limitations_preserved: Direct promoter binding and mutation-sensitive activation support a bounded STAT4-to-PRF1 gene edge in human NK cells; transcript/promoter regulation does not by itself establish perforin granule release, cytotoxic killing, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output.
